text:
Medic
Don't remember name. riptide came down and pulled him under and the undertow pulled him uderwater.
The guy was from Kanas or Nebraska and never seen water.
He was Army. He was our medic for my unit.
It was during the first couple week Nha Trang in '64.
Ron Tototz had also never been around water much. I warned him to be careful.
